### Bio:

I am a PhD student in the Department of Biostatistics at UCLA working with Dr. Sudipto Banerjee and Dr. Falco J. Bargagli Stoffi on all things Bayes and specifically, high-dimensional data analysis, survival/longitudinal data methodology, and causal inference. Outside of academics, I enjoy hiking, swimming, dancing, and exploring different matcha places. I also serve as the President of the Biostatistics Student Association (BSA) and I love hanging out with my (not-so) little golden retriever, Laken.
